name: Official inputs
rule: Every input field traces to an OFFICIAL source row
evidence_needed: Official standings / team stats / player logs with source_id

name: Priced market data
rule: Each leg has at least one timestamped, verified price
evidence_needed: Official or verified sportsbook price snapshots with timestamps

name: Sample size
rule: Priced bets must reach the power requirement
threshold: 783 priced bets for a 55% true rate at 80% power (alpha 0.05 two-sided; computed by analytics.required_n_two_proportions_vs_half)

name: Closing-line value
rule: Mean CLV versus de-vigged closing price has a 95% CI above zero

name: Out-of-sample holdout
rule: Selection rule frozen before the holdout; holdout results reported in full

name: Multiple testing
rule: Association p-value below the Bonferroni-adjusted alpha across all candidates tested
threshold: permutation p < 0.05 / k (k = number of candidates)

name: Parlay dependence
rule: Leg correlation measured from official data and applied in pricing
threshold: Measured correlation with CI and n reported
evidence_needed: Official game-level data for each leg pair

name: Rule compliance
rule: Market type permitted under the NBA 2026-27 rules and the sportsbook terms
threshold: Must be confirmed on an official source
evidence_needed: Official NBA memo or official sportsbook terms
